name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=ch16_end_scene_char_pos_x_table. 'ch16' is the chapter ID (valid 1-30 domain ID, must be kept) not a Ghidra address residue (0x52183 has no '16' tail). 'pos_x_table' correctly reflects the data type (per-character X-coordinate lookup table). Name accurately describes purpose and shape.
purpose: Per-character X battle-tile coordinate table for the chapter 16 (Ice Plain battle / Bing Yuan Zhi Zhan) end scene character placement.
logic_summary: fd2_chapter_16_end (@0x23A0A) copies all 16 bytes onto an on-stack placement block via MOVSD x4 (source pointer set at 0x23A28) and passes the block as the pos_x argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(pos_x, pos_y, 0,0, 0xF, 0x41, 0x1C, 0x1E, 2, 0x16, 0x19). The 0xF (=15) max-char-index arg confirms 16 chars (0..0xF). The helper indexes the block [char_idx] reading one byte per char (stride 1) and stores it into runtime_char.bPos_x. The sibling pos_y_table @ 0x52193 is the second MOVSD source (0x23A36) and bounds this table at exactly 16 bytes.
element_semantics: One unsigned byte per character (char index 0..0xF) giving the battle-tile X coordinate (column) where that character is placed in the chapter 16 end scene. Observed values 0x19-0x1F (25-31).
notes: Const-ness confirmed by xrefs to 0x52183 being READ/DATA only (no game writer) and the src definition already being const uint8[16]. src comment (chtab2.c lines 83-93) was already accurate and precise -> kept unchanged. Ghidra data plate at 0x52183 was empty (null) -> created a concise PLATE_COMMENT consistent with the src conclusion via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...). No logic changes. Only the shard file is staged for commit (chtab2.c untouched).
